name: First full-moon poetry
summary: The poetry gathering is in the tower yard. The English tourism page prints the night of the 15th of the first lunar month. The heritage page says the meeting happens each year and does not print the day. Both stay. The solar date moves. Check on arrival. No fee was printed. The photograph is the tower lit after dark, not the gathering.
when: Night of the 15th of the first lunar month on the English page. The heritage page prints no day. Solar date: check on arrival.
